$comment: Everything couple-specific lives here. Forkers: change names, player colors, and seasons, then run `node build-tokens.mjs`. The build fails if any text/background pair drops below WCAG AA.
$activeSeason: THE one value that swaps the theme. The build writes it as the :root default; at runtime set <html data-season> to the same id (later: from the Supabase seasons row).

ink.$why: Hierro forjado: the black steel window frames at both venues (CASO's glass canopy, Bola's steel-and-glass terrace). Primary buttons and active states.

brand.$why: Bugambilia: the pink blooms climbing CASO's brick and the city's walls. Wordmark and rare brand moments only.

celebrate.$why: Luz de vela / cempasúchil gold: the warm candle and string-light glow of evening receptions in both patios. Wins and trophies only.

players.name: Shannon
players.colorName: Ocre (CASO's mustard velvet as it reads in shade, pushed toward yellow-ochre limewash)
players.$decision: 2026-11-10: Rem picked ochre over terracotta (Barro #AD4309). Chosen from 3 candidates in shannon/eval.json; see BODA-TOKENS-v1.md §4.

dark.$note: v0.2: in dark mode the season wall keeps its daylight paint (a pale wall glared at night); dark text/soft variants unchanged
